function show(n: number): void {
  console.log("show", n);
}
function pick(flag: boolean): void | number {
  if (flag) return 1;
}
const text = "result: " + show(1);
const after = show(2) + " done";
const same = show(3) > show(4);
const both = pick(true) >= pick(false);
const negated = -show(5);
const label: string | undefined = text.length > 3 ? "long" : undefined;
const joined = label + "!";
console.log(text, after, same, both, negated, joined);
